decisions.label: Analyte
decisions.description: The sample or material being subjected to analysis.

verification.note: Exact label match. NCIT definition fits the biospecimen-category sense: a molecular or physical extract from a primary specimen prepared for analysis.
Exact specimen sense. NCIT C159203 is a Body Fluid Specimen child representing ascitic fluid biospecimen — correct in context.

decisions.label: Blood Sample
decisions.description: A small volume of blood removed for testing or storage.

verification.note: Exact label synonym match. NCIT C17610 is the canonical blood biospecimen class; definition fits the specimen/body-substance sense.

decisions.label: Bone Marrow Sample
decisions.description: A biological sample containing components collected from bone marrow of an experimental subject.

verification.note: Exact concept match. C164009 is a direct child of NCIT Biospecimen, representing a bone marrow sample.

decisions.label: Cell Specimen
decisions.description: A biospecimen comprised of purified or partially-purified cells.

verification.note: Closest NCIT concept for a cellular biospecimen category. C192998 is the parent of single-cell and bulk-cell specimen types; definition fits 'Cells' as a biospecimen category.

decisions.label: Body Fluid Specimen
decisions.description: A biospecimen that consists of a body fluid.

verification.note: C204466 is the NCIT parent class for all body fluid biospecimens (Blood, Urine, Sputum, Ascites are all children). 'Fluids' as a biospecimen category maps correctly to this concept, though it is the broader class rather than a specific fluid type.

decisions.label: Mouth Rinse Specimen
decisions.description: A sample consisting of biological material from the buccal cavity, collected by introducing a solution into the mouth, swishing, and collecting the rinse.

verification.note: Exact label match. Only term in NCIT for this concept; definition matches precisely.

decisions.label: Sputum Sample
decisions.description: A respiratory biospecimen obtained via expectoration.

verification.note: Exact label synonym match. Only NCIT sputum specimen term; definition fits the biospecimen-category sense.

decisions.label: feces
decisions.description: Portion of semisolid bodily waste discharged through the anus.

verification.note: No NCIT specimen term for stool/feces exists. UBERON:0001988 represents the substance (feces) rather than a specimen of it, but is the best available match across all surveyed ontologies. Human review recommended to confirm UBERON is acceptable or to substitute a preferred local term.

decisions.label: Tissue Sample
decisions.description: A piece of tissue removed from an organism for examination, analysis, or propagation.

verification.note: Exact label synonym match. C19697 is the canonical NCIT tissue biospecimen class; definition fits the specimen/category sense.
Exact label synonym match. C189126 is the canonical NCIT urine specimen class.
